body: Free admission sounds sulit, pero ang tunay na cost ay travel + isang workday. So huwag gawing museum walk: pumili muna ng 3-5 vendors/problems at magdala ng scorecard—API/data access, calibration, false-call rate, cycle time, deployment hours, at actual engineer-hours saved. Kapag walang baseline-versus-after numbers, brochure value lang iyon. If practical ang Makuhari trip, the best ROI is direct technical comparison in one day, not collecting every catalog.

claims.text: The event's practical value is highest when attendance is structured around a small set of measurable engineering questions rather than broad browsing.
claims.basis: Practical inference from the article's free-admission, concentrated-vendor and evidence-validation framing
